Welcome to Venezuela! 🇻🇪 Where the minimum wage is 130 bolivars — under $1 USD for an entire month of work.

That wage can't even buy a kilo of cheese. So how do millions actually survive? Remittances, dollars, and pure hustle — this is the Venezuela nobody shows you.
